# Read in new samples

```{r}
final.all <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/SO_ctcl.new.final.filtered.rds")
CTCL_seurat.merged <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/updated_seurat_obj.rds")
```


```{r}
#Read in new data
final.all <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/ctcl.new.final.rds")

final.all$barcodes.match <- paste0(final.all$donor_and_number, "_", final.all$barcode_simple, "_", final.all$donor_and_number)

CTCL_seurat.merged <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/updated_seurat_obj.rds")

Idents(final.all) <- final.all$orig.ident
asdf <- merge(final.all, CTCL_seurat.merged)

asdf$orig.ident <- as.character(asdf$orig.ident)
# Update the orig.ident column directly
asdf$orig.ident[asdf$orig.ident == "CTCL1"] <- "S153"
asdf$orig.ident[asdf$orig.ident == "CTCL2"] <- "S154"
```

# Read in and process data
```{r}
inventory <- readxl::read_xlsx("FileInventoryUpdatesRyan.xlsx")

meta <- asdf[[]]
meta$barcode <- colnames(asdf)
df.samples <- as.data.frame(table(asdf$orig.ident))

adt.assay <- GetAssayData(asdf, assay = "ADT")
saveRDS(adt.assay, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/adt.assay.rds")

asdf@assays$ADT <- NULL
Idents(asdf) <- asdf$orig.ident

#saveRDS(asdf, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/asdf.all.rds")
asdf <- R2easygene::update_genes(Seurat_obj = asdf, select_assay = "RNA", return_seurat = T, min.cells = 3, min.features = 100)

colnames(asdf@assays$RNA@layers$counts) <- colnames(asdf)
rownames(asdf@assays$RNA@layers$counts) <- rownames(asdf)

meta <- merge(meta, inventory[,1:14], by.x = "orig.ident", by.y = "Sample")

barcodes <- meta$barcode
rownames(meta) <- barcodes

asdf[[]] <- meta

asdf.new <- UpdateSeuratObject(asdf)
asdf <- asdf.new

VlnPlot(asdf, features = "percent.mt", pt.size = 0, y.max = 20)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "percent.rb", pt.size = 0)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "nCount_RNA", pt.size = 0, y.max = 30000)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "nFeature_RNA", pt.size = 0)
VlnPlot(asdf, features = "HBB", pt.size = 0, y.max = 500)
table(asdf$db.class)

###############################################################################
saveRDS(asdf, "~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/asdf.all.unfiltered.rds")
asdf <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/asdf.all.unfiltered.rds")
```


```{r}
asdf <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/asdf.all.unfiltered.rds")    
final.all <- readRDS("~/hpchome/ctcl4.4/ctcl.new.final.rds")

final.all$barcodes.match <- colnames(final.all)

intersect(final.all$barcodes.match, asdf$barcode)

intersect(colnames(final.all), colnames(asdf))

asdf$celltype.new.study <- final.all$cell_type

table(asdf$celltype.new.study)

asdf <- subset(asdf, db.class == "singlet")

s.genes <- cc.genes$s.genes
g2m.genes <- cc.genes$g2m.genes

asdf <- NormalizeData(asdf)
asdf <- CellCycleScoring(asdf, s.features = s.genes, g2m.features = g2m.genes, set.ident = F)
asdf$cc.dif <- asdf$S.Score - asdf$G2M.Score


rna <- as.data.frame(rownames(asdf))
colnames(rna) <- "genes"
genes <- rna$genes
tcr_genes <- grep("^TR[ABDG][VDJC]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
ig_genes <- grep("^IG[JHKL][VDJC]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
cell_cycle <- c(s.genes, g2m.genes)
mito <- grep("^MT-", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
ribo <- grep("^RP[SL]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE)
hb_genes <- grep("^HB[AB]", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)
sex_genes <- grep("^RPS4Y1|^KDM5D|^UTY|^DDX3Y|XIST", rownames(asdf), value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)

library(future)

asdf <- FindVariableFeatures(asdf, nfeatures = 3000)
VariableFeatures(asdf) <- setdiff(VariableFeatures(asdf), c(tcr_genes, ig_genes, cell_cycle, mito, ribo, hb_genes, sex_genes))
asdf <- ScaleData(asdf, vars.to.regress = c("nFeature_RNA", "percent.rb", "percent.mt", "S.Score", "G2M.Score"))
asdf <- RunPCA(asdf)
asdf <- RunHarmony(asdf, group.by.vars = "orig.ident", 
				reduction = "pca", assay.use = "RNA", reduction.save = "harmony", ncores = 30)
asdf <- RunUMAP(asdf, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony")
asdf <- FindNeighbors(asdf, dims = 1:30, reduction = "harmony", assay = "RNA", nn.method = "annoy", annoy.metric = "euclidean")
asdf <- FindClusters(asdf, resolution = .1, n.start = 5, n.iter = 10)
asdf <- FindNeighbors(asdf, dims = 1:2, reduction = "umap", assay = "RNA", nn.method = "annoy", annoy.metric = "euclidean", graph.name = c("umap_nn", "umap_snn"))
asdf <- FindClusters(asdf, resolution = .01, n.start = 5, n.iter = 10, graph.name = "umap_snn")

DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "orig.ident", alpha = .1, pt.size = .1, raster = F, shuffle = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "RNA_snn_res.0.1", alpha = .1, pt.size = .1, raster = F, shuffle = T, label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "umap_snn_res.0.1", alpha = .1, pt.size = .1, raster = F, shuffle = T, label = T)+NoLegend()
DimPlot(asdf, group.by = "umap_snn_res.0.01", alpha = .1, pt.size = .1, raster = F, shuffle = T, label = T)+NoLegend()
```


```{r}
Idents(asdf) <- asdf$umap_snn_res.0.01
markers <- FindAllMarkers(asdf, max.cells.per.ident = 5000, min.pct = .1, logfc.threshold = .5, only.pos = T)
```
